timeline.title: Creation
timeline.summary: God creates and orders the world, giving humanity a vocation within it.

timeline.title: The garden and humanity’s calling
timeline.summary: The human being is placed in the garden to cultivate and care for it.

timeline.title: Disobedience and departure from Eden
timeline.summary: Disobedience breaks trust and leads to departure from the garden.

timeline.title: Cain and Abel
timeline.summary: Cain kills his brother, and God confronts him about the blood shed.

timeline.title: Noah and the ark
timeline.summary: In a world marked by violence, Noah receives instructions to build the ark.

timeline.title: The flood
timeline.summary: Noah, his family and the animals enter the ark before the waters arrive.

timeline.title: The covenant with Noah
timeline.summary: God establishes a covenant with Noah, his descendants and living creatures.

timeline.title: The tower of Babel
timeline.summary: The building of a city and tower ends with the scattering of peoples.

timeline.title: The calling of Abraham
timeline.summary: Abram leaves his homeland in response to a call accompanied by promises.

timeline.title: The covenant with Abraham
timeline.summary: Abram voices doubts about descendants and receives a promise confirmed by covenant.

timeline.title: The birth of Isaac
timeline.summary: Sarah gives birth to Isaac, the son promised to Abraham.

timeline.title: Abraham is tested
timeline.summary: Abraham takes Isaac to the mountain; a messenger stops the sacrifice and a ram is offered.

timeline.title: Jacob’s dream at Bethel
timeline.summary: During his journey, Jacob dreams and receives the promise of God’s presence.

timeline.title: Jacob receives the name Israel
timeline.summary: Before meeting Esau, Jacob wrestles through the night and receives a new name.

timeline.title: Joseph is sold
timeline.summary: Joseph’s brothers sell him, and he is taken to Egypt.

timeline.title: Joseph reveals himself to his brothers
timeline.summary: Joseph reveals his identity and invites the family to live in Egypt during the famine.

timeline.title: The birth of Moses
timeline.summary: Moses is preserved as a baby and grows up in Pharaoh’s daughter’s household.

timeline.title: The call at the burning bush
timeline.summary: God calls Moses to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.

timeline.title: The first Passover
timeline.summary: Households receive instructions for Passover on the night of departure from Egypt.

timeline.title: Leaving Egypt and crossing the sea
timeline.summary: The Israelites cross the sea while the Egyptian army pursues them.

timeline.title: Manna in the wilderness
timeline.summary: The people receive food in the wilderness and instructions for gathering it.

timeline.title: The covenant at Sinai
timeline.summary: Israel reaches Sinai and receives commandments guiding its life as a people.

timeline.title: The golden calf
timeline.summary: During Moses’ absence, the people make a golden calf; Moses intercedes.

timeline.title: The spies and the crisis of trust
timeline.summary: The spies’ report divides the people and leads to their refusal to enter the land.

timeline.title: The death of Moses
timeline.summary: Moses sees the land before dying, and Joshua takes up leadership.

timeline.title: Crossing the Jordan
timeline.summary: Under Joshua’s leadership, the people cross the Jordan.

timeline.title: Jericho
timeline.summary: Joshua recounts the taking of Jericho and the preservation of Rahab and her family.

timeline.title: Renewing the covenant
timeline.summary: Joshua gathers the people at Shechem to recall their history and renew their commitment to God.

timeline.title: The period of the judges
timeline.summary: Judges presents cycles of unfaithfulness, oppression, cries for help and deliverance.

timeline.title: Deborah and Barak
timeline.summary: Deborah guides Barak in the struggle against Sisera’s forces.

timeline.title: Gideon and the small army
timeline.summary: Gideon’s army is reduced before confronting the Midianites.

timeline.title: Ruth and Naomi
timeline.summary: Ruth accompanies Naomi to Bethlehem, and the story ends with a family linked to David’s line.

timeline.title: The calling of Samuel
timeline.summary: Samuel hears God’s call while serving with Eli.

timeline.title: Israel asks for a king
timeline.summary: The people ask for a king, and Samuel describes the costs of this form of rule.

timeline.title: Saul is anointed
timeline.summary: Samuel anoints Saul, who is later presented to the people as king.

timeline.title: The anointing of David
timeline.summary: Samuel goes to Jesse’s house and anoints David.

timeline.title: David and Goliath
timeline.summary: David faces Goliath while the armies of Israel and the Philistines are gathered.

timeline.title: David reigns and takes Jerusalem
timeline.summary: David is recognized as king over all Israel and takes Jerusalem.

timeline.title: The promise to David’s house
timeline.summary: Nathan delivers a promise to David concerning his descendants and kingdom.

timeline.title: Nathan confronts David
timeline.summary: After David’s actions against Bathsheba and Uriah, Nathan confronts the king.

timeline.title: Solomon asks for wisdom
timeline.summary: Early in his reign, Solomon asks for discernment to govern.

timeline.title: The dedication of the temple
timeline.summary: Solomon gathers the people for the temple’s dedication and offers a prayer.

timeline.title: The division of the kingdom
timeline.summary: After Solomon, conflict with Rehoboam results in the separation of the kingdoms.

timeline.title: Elijah on Mount Carmel
timeline.summary: Elijah confronts the prophets of Baal before the people.

timeline.title: Elijah at Horeb
timeline.summary: Elijah flees, receives care and finds renewed direction for his mission.

timeline.title: Elisha and Naaman
timeline.summary: Naaman seeks healing and receives instructions from Elisha that he initially rejects.

timeline.title: Amos calls for justice
timeline.summary: Amos denounces injustice and confronts worship disconnected from the people’s lives.

timeline.title: The calling of Isaiah
timeline.summary: Isaiah recounts a vision, his cleansing and his commission to proclaim a message.

timeline.title: The fall of Samaria
timeline.summary: The northern kingdom falls under Assyrian rule, and part of its population is deported.

timeline.title: Josiah and the book of the Law
timeline.summary: A book is found in the temple, and Josiah leads a renewal of the covenant.

timeline.title: Jeremiah and the temple sermon
timeline.summary: Jeremiah challenges confidence in the temple when daily conduct contradicts the covenant.

timeline.title: The fall of Jerusalem and exile
timeline.summary: Jerusalem is taken, the temple is destroyed and another deportation follows.

timeline.title: Lament for Jerusalem
timeline.summary: Lamentations gives voice to the grief of a devastated city.

timeline.title: The letter to the exiles
timeline.summary: Jeremiah instructs the exiles to build a life where they have been taken.

timeline.title: Daniel at court
timeline.summary: Young men from Judah are trained for service at the Babylonian court and face questions of faithfulness.

timeline.title: The fiery furnace
timeline.summary: Three of Daniel’s companions refuse to worship the royal image and are thrown into the furnace.

timeline.title: The vision of dry bones
timeline.summary: Ezekiel sees bones receive life and hears a promise of restoration for Israel.

timeline.title: Cyrus’s decree and the return
timeline.summary: Ezra opens with Cyrus’s authorization to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

timeline.title: The altar and the foundations
timeline.summary: The returnees restore the altar and lay the temple’s foundations amid joy and weeping.

timeline.title: Haggai encourages rebuilding
timeline.summary: Haggai questions the community’s priorities and encourages the resumption of building.

timeline.title: Completion of the second temple
timeline.summary: The temple is completed and dedicated, followed by the celebration of Passover.

timeline.title: Esther intercedes for her people
timeline.summary: Esther decides to approach the king and exposes the threat against her people.

timeline.title: Ezra and the teaching of the Law
timeline.summary: Ezra arrives in Jerusalem, portrayed as devoted to studying, practicing and teaching the Law.

timeline.title: Nehemiah and the walls
timeline.summary: Nehemiah organizes the rebuilding of Jerusalem’s walls amid opposition.

timeline.title: The public reading of the Law
timeline.summary: The people gather to hear the Law, and the text is explained to the assembly.

timeline.title: The announcement to Mary
timeline.summary: Mary receives the announcement of Jesus’ birth and responds to the call.

timeline.title: The birth of Jesus
timeline.summary: Jesus is born in Bethlehem, and shepherds receive the news and visit the child.

timeline.title: Baptism and the beginning of the mission
timeline.summary: Jesus is baptized by John, goes into the wilderness and begins proclaiming God’s kingdom.

timeline.title: Jesus announces his mission
timeline.summary: In the Nazareth synagogue, Jesus reads Isaiah and relates the passage to his work.

timeline.title: The calling of the first disciples
timeline.summary: Jesus calls fishermen to follow him after an unexpected catch.

timeline.title: The Sermon on the Mount
timeline.summary: Jesus teaches about the kingdom, righteousness, prayer and everyday life.

timeline.title: Parables of the kingdom
timeline.summary: Jesus uses images of seeds, soil and growth to teach.

timeline.title: The feeding of the multitude
timeline.summary: Jesus welcomes the crowd, teaches and shares food with them.

timeline.title: The transfiguration
timeline.summary: Three disciples see Jesus transfigured, accompanied by Moses and Elijah.

timeline.title: The entry into Jerusalem
timeline.summary: Jesus reaches Jerusalem amid acclamation and enters the temple.

timeline.title: The last supper
timeline.summary: Jesus shares supper with the disciples before his arrest.

timeline.title: Prayer and arrest
timeline.summary: Jesus prays in Gethsemane and is arrested while his disciples scatter.

timeline.title: The crucifixion of Jesus
timeline.summary: Jesus is condemned, crucified and buried.

timeline.title: The resurrection and the encounters
timeline.summary: The tomb is found empty, and Luke recounts the disciples’ encounters with Jesus.

timeline.title: The ascension and the waiting
timeline.summary: Jesus instructs the disciples about witness and is taken up; they remain gathered.

timeline.title: Pentecost
timeline.summary: The disciples receive the Spirit, and Peter proclaims the message to the crowd.

timeline.title: Life in the first community
timeline.summary: Acts describes teaching, prayer, meals and sharing among the first disciples.

timeline.title: Stephen and conflict in Jerusalem
timeline.summary: Stephen serves the community, is accused and is killed after his testimony.

timeline.title: Philip and the Ethiopian traveler
timeline.summary: Philip meets a traveler reading Isaiah and speaks with him about Jesus.

timeline.title: Saul on the road to Damascus
timeline.summary: Saul encounters Jesus on the road, loses his sight and receives a visit from Ananias.

timeline.title: Peter and Cornelius
timeline.summary: Peter visits Cornelius’s household and proclaims Jesus to those gathered.

timeline.title: The sending of Barnabas and Saul
timeline.summary: The Antioch community sends Barnabas and Saul, who travel through new cities.

timeline.title: The meeting in Jerusalem
timeline.summary: The community debates what to require of Gentiles coming to faith.

timeline.title: Paul and Silas in Philippi
timeline.summary: In Philippi, the mission includes meeting Lydia and the imprisonment of Paul and Silas.

timeline.title: Paul in Athens
timeline.summary: Paul engages in dialogue in Athens and proclaims his message at the Areopagus.

timeline.title: Paul reaches Rome
timeline.summary: After the voyage and shipwreck, Paul reaches Rome and continues teaching in custody.
